dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular circular and semi-circular perimeters with high-contrast light-tone boundaries, exhibiting a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity outer edges to dark-toned centers. Most prominent structures are in the mid-dorsal and mid-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate to high density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity clusters concentrated near the cephalic region and along the dorsal ridge, appearing as solid pixel groups without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triangular geometric relationship is formed by the centroids of three large macro-annuli in the mid-body section, with a secondary linear-oblique alignment of smaller centroids observed in the anterior-dorsal quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral flipper exhibits a fine-grained, high-frequency speckled texture that is distinct from the larger macro-annuli structures found on the main torso.
